# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct / 贡献者行为准则

## Our Pledge / 我们的承诺

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in the iot-gateway community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

我们作为成员、贡献者与维护者承诺：无论年龄、体型、可见或不可见的残障、族裔、性别特征、性别认同与表达、经验水平、教育程度、社会经济地位、国籍、外貌、种族、宗教或性取向如何，均让每位参与 iot-gateway 社区的人免受骚扰，获得尊重与友好的体验。

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.

我们承诺以有助于开放、欢迎、多元、包容和健康社区的方式行事与互动。

## Our Standards / 行为标准

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Demonstrating empathy and kindness toward other people / 对他人展现同理心与善意
- Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences / 尊重不同的意见、观点与经验
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback / 提出并优雅地接受建设性反馈
- Focusing on what is best for the community / 以社区整体利益为重

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- The use of sexualized language or imagery / 使用性化的语言或图像
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks / 挑衅、侮辱、贬损言论，人身或政治攻击
- Public or private harassment / 公开或私下骚扰
- Publishing others' private information without explicit permission / 未经明确许可公开他人隐私信息

## Enforcement / 执行

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project maintainer at **15289288565@163.com**. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

如遇侮辱、骚扰或其他不可接受的行为，可向项目维护者 **15289288565@163.com** 举报。所有举报都会及时、公正地审查与处理。

## Attribution / 来源

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
本行为准则改编自 [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org) 2.1 版。
